message.content:
**Average (median) house price in California (2024‑mid)**  
- **Median listing price:** ≈ $850 000  
- **Average (mean) price:** ≈ $1 050 000  

> *Sources:*  
> • Zillow Research – “California Home Prices” (latest quarterly report, 2024‑Q2)  
> • Redfin Data Center – “California Median Home Price” (2024‑June)  
> • U.S. Census Bureau – ACS 5‑Year Estimates (housing values, 2023)

> **Note:**  
> • The *median* price is often used as the “average” in real‑estate discussions because it is less affected by extreme outliers (e.g., ultra‑luxury homes).  
> • The *mean* (average) price is higher because a small number of very expensive properties pull the average up.  
> • Prices vary widely by region: San Francisco Bay Area and Los Angeles County are above the state median, while Central Valley and rural areas are below.
